test_title: PYST 82: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Six teachers Jatin, Abhi, Gopal, Heena, Ishaa and Rohit are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Abhi is second to the left of Heena. Rohit is third to the right of Heena. Gopal is second to the right of Jatin. Rohit is second to the left of Jatin. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Abhi?
solution:
Given: Six teachers Jatin, Abhi, Gopal, Heena, Ishaa and Rohit are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre.

1) Abhi is second to the left of Heena.

2) Rohit is third to the right of Heena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f3017bb49762eabdf2be44d19346b61e38a425a672724b5dafd16e63e7d8de8.png] 

3) Rohit is second to the left of Jatin.

4) Gopal is second to the right of Jatin.

After positioning Rohit and Jatin only one position is left which will be occupied by the only teacher left i.e. Ishaa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94c949ee88cf9e66463933e7e7a49b3750917303a37d959c81047fbd68a06503.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement **Jatin** sits to the immediate right of Abhi.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
